gaps.gap: Bubble Starter's workload-unit cap is a prototype tier — real production SaaS traffic hits the 175K WU ceiling inside the first busy week and forces the upgrade to Growth at $119/month, not the $32 figure every top post quotes
gaps.covered_in: Bubble vs Lovable — the web SaaS decision at $25–$119/month

gaps.gap: Multi-tenant auth, Stripe webhook retry, role-based permissions, and per-tenant data isolation are the real 60-70% wall every no-code SaaS platform hits — the demo screens are easy, the production plumbing is where tools diverge
gaps.covered_in: The 60-70% wall every no-code SaaS platform hits

gaps.gap: Annual-billed 12-month invoice math varies wildly (FlutterFlow 25% discount vs Bubble 20% vs Glide monthly-only) and flips the mobile pick between FlutterFlow at $351/yr and Adalo at $624/yr for cash-constrained founders
gaps.covered_in: The 12-month invoice reality — how annual discounts move the pick

gaps.gap: Stripe/Razorpay integration difficulty is uneven across tools — Emergent bundles checkout + sign-in + hosting from the first build; Lovable requires manual Stripe-via-Supabase wiring; Bubble needs plugin + workflow setup — and this gap dictates which tool actually ships a paying customer this week
gaps.covered_in: Payments, auth, and multi-tenant data — the no-code SaaS checklist most posts skip
